newsitem.title: USA: Spectran sees qtly earnings up from yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Spectran sees qtly earnings up from yr ago.

text.p: SpecTran Corp said Friday it expects continued improvement in quarterly earnings per share compared with 1996.
Speaking at the company's annual meeting, Raymond Jaeger, SpecTran chairman, president and chief executive officer, said, "Our objective is to reach record earnings for the full year."
SpecTran, headquartered in Sturbridge, Mass., develops, manufactures and markets glass optical fibers and value-added fiber optic products.
Jaeger told shareholders that SpecTran's recent public stock offering had provided the company with funds needed to complete planned capacity expansions.
A dramatic improvement in sales is expected when the company begins ramping up capacity in 1998, he said.
At the meeting, shareholders re-elected two directors and ratified the appointment of KPMG Peat Marwick as SpecTran's independent auditors for 1997, the company said.
